question: In the context of the passage, what does the word “mosaic” most likely mean?
solution: The correct answer is: **Option (1) i.e. A blended pattern**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **“mosaic”** in the passage refers to a combination of different elements coming together to create a complete and beautiful picture or pattern. (विभिन्न रंगों और टुकड़ों से बना सुन्दर मिश्रण/सजावट) • **Example:** The city’s culture is a mosaic of traditions from around the world. • Here, the author uses “mosaic of consciousness” to describe how diverse emotions and experiences (such as joy and sorrow) blend together to make life richer and more human. (यहाँ 'mosaic' का अर्थ है- मिश्रित पैटर्न, जिसमें विभिन्न भावनाएँ और अनुभव मिलकर जीवन की सुंदरता बनाते हैं।) • **Example:** Life’s mosaic is made up of both happy and sad moments. • Hence, in this context, “mosaic” most likely means “a blended pattern”. Therefore, the correct answer is- A blended pattern [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **A rigid structure** (कठोर संरचना): Something that is inflexible or does not change its form. • **Example:** The old bridge was built as a rigid structure to withstand heavy loads. • **A hollow emotion** (खोखला भाव): A feeling that lacks true substance, depth, or meaning. • **Example:** His apology sounded like a hollow emotion, without real regret. • **A musical rhythm** (संगीत की लय): A repeated pattern of sounds or beats in music. • **Example:** The dancers moved in perfect time to the musical rhythm. 48:Te3e, The correct answer is **Option 1**.
